triage.note: The near side of the 2006-12-15 boundary, six and a half months before it. A May-fiscal-year registrant filing in July 2006 is still on the pre-33-8732A captions for Items 10 and 13, and this filing writes both of them: 'Item 10. Directors and Executive Officers of the Registrant' and 'Item 13. Certain Relationships and Related Transactions'. MEASURED PRE-FIX (2026-08-20): item 10 title 'Directors, Executive Officers and Corporate Governance', item 13 title 'Certain Relationships and Related Transactions, and Director Independence'. Without this fixture the 10/13 correction could have been satisfied by any date between 2003-08-14 and 2006-12-15; paired with bac-2006 (period end 2006-12-31, era-label-bac-2006.json) it brackets the boundary to a seven-month window that contains exactly one rule date. The non-calendar fiscal year is what makes the pair possible at all -- both filings are 'FY2006' and they fall on opposite sides.
